text:
Two small corn cob pieces on a plate. One is about 3 cm long and the other is a short round slice about 2 cm thick, both roughly 4 cm in diameter. Together they come to roughly 1.5 small cobs' worth of segments, so about 60 g of kernels in total. Corn is about 96 kcal per 100 g, so 60 g is about 58 kcal. The cob itself adds mass, but I'll count the edible part as roughly 70 g and the energy as about 65 kcal.
